lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you ever think about us coming over to talk with you? Did you worry about that at all?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: (nods “yes”) Yeah. I was scared the first time I had ta go, a, when I was up north talkin’ to them people.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Had Steven told you some things to tell, to say to the police?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He just told me not to say anything, that a, that his lawyer said not to say anything.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: If Steven tells us that you did all of this, that, that yo-you ha-had started it and had killed her and stuff, is that true?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Don't forget your Pepsi down there. (Brendan nods “yes”) We're gonna step out for a couple of more minutes OK? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Do you need to use the restroom?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Do you want somethin’ to eat?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Looks like you're a little hungry.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Should we get you a sandwich?
